name: Ilan iMA
summary: Ilan iMA is a Martingale-style grid EA that uses the iMA (Moving Average) indicator as its entry signal. When a trade goes against the position, it opens additional orders with increasing lot sizes at fixed pip intervals, aiming to recover losses on a reversal. It is a classic Ilan-family EA adapted for MQL5 with MA-based trend filtering.
summary_zh: Ilan iMA是一个基于马丁格尔策略的网格EA，使用iMA（移动平均线）指标作为入场信号。当持仓亏损时，它会在固定间距加仓并倍增手数，期望价格反转时整体回本获利。这是经典Ilan系列EA的MQL5版本，加入了MA趋势过滤。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是马丁格尔加仓法，即每次亏损后加倍下注以期回本。入场条件基于iMA移动平均线指标判断趋势方向，当价格被认为处于有利趋势时开首仓。如果市场走势不利，EA会在设定的固定点数间隔（Step参数）后再次开仓，手数按Multiplier倍数递增。出场条件是当所有同向持仓的整体浮动利润达到TakeProfit设定值时全部平仓。仓位管理采用典型的马丁格尔倍增公式：第N层手数=初始手数×Multiplier^(N-1)。资金管理方面缺乏硬性止损，完全依赖价格最终回归来解套，这在强单边行情中可能导致爆仓。整体策略属于高风险类型，适合震荡行情但极度惧怕单边趋势。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the Martingale position-sizing method, which doubles the lot size after each losing trade in hopes of recovering all losses on a single winning reversal. Entry conditions are based on the iMA (Moving Average) indicator to determine the trend direction, opening the first position when price aligns with the perceived trend. If the market moves against the position, the EA opens additional orders at a fixed pip interval (Step parameter), with lot sizes multiplied by the Multiplier factor each time. Exit conditions trigger when the combined floating profit of all same-direction positions reaches the TakeProfit target, at which point all positions are closed simultaneously. Position sizing follows the classic Martingale formula: Nth level lot = Initial Lot × Multiplier^(N-1). Money management lacks a hard stop-loss, relying entirely on eventual price mean-reversion to escape drawdowns, which can lead to account blowout during strong trending markets.
pros: 在震荡行情中表现优异，能持续获利
MA趋势过滤减少了逆势开仓的概率
整体止盈机制确保所有层级同时获利出场
参数可调性强，用户可根据品种特性灵活配置
pros_en: Performs well in ranging/sideways markets, generating consistent profits
MA trend filter reduces the probability of counter-trend initial entries
Unified take-profit mechanism ensures all levels exit profitably together
Highly configurable parameters allow users to adapt to different instrument characteristics
cons: 马丁格尔加仓在强单边行情中可能导致爆仓
缺乏硬性止损，风险不可控
加仓层数越多所需保证金呈指数增长，对账户资金要求极高
没有考虑点差和手续费对利润的侵蚀效应
回撤可能极大，心理承受压力大
cons_en: Martingale position sizing can lead to account blowout during strong trending markets
No hard stop-loss means risk is unbounded and uncontrollable
Margin requirements grow exponentially with each level, demanding very large account equity
Does not account for the erosion of profit by spreads and commissions
Drawdowns can be extreme, requiring significant psychological tolerance
improvements: 增加硬性止损和最大回撤限制，防止爆仓
加入点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免高成本时段交易
考虑使用动态Step代替固定间隔，根据波动率自适应调整加仓距离
增加总仓位风险百分比控制，限制单次系列最大亏损占账户比例
improvements_en: Add a hard stop-loss and maximum drawdown limit to prevent account blowout
Implement spread filter and trading session filter to avoid high-cost periods
Consider dynamic Step based on ATR/volatility instead of fixed pip intervals for adaptive spacing
Add a total portfolio risk percentage control to cap the maximum loss per trade series as a fraction of account equity

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍增手数在连续亏损时呈指数增长，极易爆仓
无硬性止损，强单边行情下亏损无上限
无点差过滤，高波动时段加仓成本急剧上升
risk_points_en: Martingale lot multiplication grows exponentially during consecutive losses,easily leading to margin call
No hard stop-loss means unlimited losses in strong unidirectional markets
No spread filter causes rapidly escalating costs when adding positions during high-volatility periods

When a trade goes against the position, it opens additional orders with increasing lot sizes at fixed pip intervals, aiming to recover losses on a reversal. It is a classic Ilan-family EA adapted for MQL5 with MA-based trend filtering.
